column2: I'd like to recap our previous sessions, but first, how do you feel about it?...
It just happend, I wasn't there.
Well, we don't have to talk about this if you're not ready.
Tell me a little about your family, how is your husband?
he knows things and he doesn't want to talk to anyone.
He is hiding everything in the basement.
How does that make you feel?
Do you feel that it is affecting the trust between you?
I need to know what he's hiding from me.
Last night I saw him putting his keys in the nightstand before going to sleep.
